mapper.insert: insert into account_users (id, account, email, name, phone, status, password, created_by) values (#{user.id}, #{user.account}, #{user.email}, #{user.name}, #{user.phone}, #{user.status}, #{user.password}, #{user.createdBy})
mapper.update: update account_users set account = #{user.account}, email = #{user.email}, name = #{user.name}, phone = #{user.phone}, updated_by = #{user.updatedBy}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{user.id}

select id, account, email, name, phone, status, password, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from account_users where account = #{account}
